[SWS_DM_00374] Support of UDS service ReadDTCInformation, Subfunction 0x19
⌈
The Diagnostic Server instance shall support Sub-
function
0x19
(reportUserDefMemoryDTCExtDataRecordByDTCNumber)
of
the UDS service 0x19 ReadDTCInformation according to ISO 14229-1[1], provided the
configuration contains a DiagnosticReadDTCInformation of category ’RE-
PORT_USER_DEF_MEMORY_DTC_EXT_DATA_RECORD_BY_DTC_NUMBER’.
⌋
